# Synthetic audit fixture: machine serial numbers (SPEC §27) in the serial
# label spellings; a `machine` prefix word before the matched span needs no
# handling of its own, because the label matches a span inside the
# lowercased line. The detector anchors on a PROPERTY, not a positional
# pattern: one post-label token of 8-plus carrying BOTH a letter and a
# digit, however sparse the interleaving (`ABCDEFG1` and `ABC1234Z` below
# are the sparse-interleaving misses a positional grammar let through,
# from review thread 3887950232). Free text, pure-digit runs (a Terraform
# state file's growth counter) and pure-letter words carry no such token
# and never trip. Synthetic values.
Machine Serial Number: C02ZQ0ABC123
Machine Serial Number: ABC12345
Machine Serial Number: ABCDEFG1
serial_number = "ABC1234Z"
serial_number = "C02ZQ0ABC123"
"SerialNumber": "1A2B3C4D5E"
SERIAL-NUMBER: pf-2x9k1q
serial:CND1234567
# Prose and reference forms that must stay silent.
serial number: see the underside of the device
Serial Number: unknown
serial_number = each.value.serial
"serial": 123456789
# Letters-digits serial with the vendor hyphen spelling, and the
# Makefile :=: assignment separator (both found by the selftest
# spelling matrix). Synthetic values.
serial_number = "ABC-12345"
serial := CND1234567
Machine Serial Number: 12345678
